error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot see or change answer keys. Owners, admins and authors can.
error.RELEASE_NOT_FOUND: That release no longer exists. Refresh and choose another.
error.PUBLISHED_RELEASE_IMMUTABLE: Published releases never change. Create a draft of the next version and edit it there.
error.RELEASE_CHANGED: Someone changed this draft since you opened it. Refresh, then make your change again.
error.INVALID_KEY: Check the key: every field is needed, the right option must be one of the question's options and the allowed difference cannot be negative.
error.KEY_NOT_EDITABLE: This question's key is held by an installed evaluator and is not edited here.
error.FIXTURES_FAIL: Some test answers would be graded the wrong way. Check the change, then tick “Save anyway” if that is intended.
error.COURSE_INVALID: The draft would no longer be a valid course with this change. Undo it and try again.
error.RUBRIC_VERSION_REQUIRED: Changed criteria need a new rubric version, one that has not been published with other criteria.
error.RUBRIC_NOT_FOUND: That rubric is not in this release. Refresh.
error.ASSESSMENT_NOT_FOUND: That question is not in this release. Refresh.
error.FIXTURE_ANSWER_INVALID: That answer does not fit the question (for example an option it does not have, or a unit it does not use). Change it and add again.
error.FIXTURE_DUPLICATE: This question already has that test answer.
error.FIXTURE_LIMIT: This question or course has reached its limit of test answers. Remove some first.
error.FIXTURE_NOT_RUNNABLE: Test answers for code and written questions are not run here.
error.FIXTURE_NOT_FOUND: That test answer was already removed. Refresh.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the values and try again.
error.unavailable: This could not be done. Nothing changed; try again.
